_comment: Copy this file into data/tournaments/, rename it to the tournament's id (e.g. 2026-10-03.json), fill it in, then add that id to data/manifest.json. Delete this _comment field — JSON has no real comments.
label: Human-readable label shown on the site, e.g. 'October 3'
_rounds_comment: Optional. If you have real per-round scores this time, fill in 'rounds' below and delete this field and the 'rounds': null line above it. Each match's team ids refer to a pair's 'id' above. If you don't have round data, leave 'rounds' as null — the site will just show tournament totals, same as August/September.
source: Optional note on where this data came from.
